# MM-P2-L4-HP03 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Scope
- This manual covers routine maintenance and verification tasks required to maintain safe operation of the Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03). It applies to maintenance technicians and shift engineers performing mechanical and hydraulic inspections and adjustments.

Tools
- Standard hand tools and calibrated torque wrench capable of applying the specified bolt torque.  
- Hydraulic system test gauge and pressure-rated hoses compatible with system service ports.  
- Personal protective equipment per site policy.

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out EQ-P2-L4-HP03 per SOP-P2-L4-01 before any work begins. Follow machine-specific isolation points and tagout procedures referenced in SOP-P2-L4-01.  
- Perform a visual inspection of hydraulic lines, fittings, and the main ram for signs of leakage, wear, or damage. If any abnormal condition is found, stop and escalate per ECN-2026-042.  
- Verify system pressure using the hydraulic system test gauge at the recommended service port. Confirm the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar. Do not operate the press above this pressure.  
- Tighten the main ram bolt to the specified value. The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 1575 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and follow the bolt manufacturer’s tightening sequence if available.  
- After adjustments, bleed the hydraulic system per established practice and remove isolation following SOP-P2-L4-01. Return the press to service only when all systems are verified functional and no leaks are present.

Acceptance criteria
- No hydraulic leaks at fittings, hoses, or ram seals under the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) of 320 bar.  
- Main ram bolt torqued to the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) of 1575 N·m as verified on a calibrated torque wrench.  
- All lockout/tagout steps completed and documented per SOP-P2-L4-01. Any deviations must be reported and managed per ECN-2026-042 and SB-1007.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-042  
- SB-1007  
- SOP-P2-L4-01
